$comment: Every binary asset the modpack ships, with its licence. tools/build/asset_sets.py reads it: the build puts `files` of a set into its feature's package at `target`, with the licence and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; tools/assets/render.py makes `files` from `sources`. Regenerate THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md with `python tools/build/asset_sets.py --write`.

sets.title: Crosshair centre marks
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.contents: 10 centre marks (dot, cross, ring, chevron, streamer, colorblind, triad, arcs, aim_box, stack): SVG sources, RGBA PNG 64 and 128 px
sets.fair_play: A static image drawn at the client's own reticle centre; computes nothing.

sets.title: Crosshair centre marks in six colours
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.contents: 5 one-colour centre marks (dot, cross, ring, brackets, diamond): SVG sources, RGBA PNG 64 and 128 px in white, green, yellow, cyan, magenta and red
sets.fair_play: A static image drawn at the client's own reticle centre; computes nothing.

sets.title: Crosshair Pack 1.1 (5 of 200)
sets.author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
sets.copyright: Kenney Vleugels, dedicated to the public domain
sets.contents: crosshair-016, -021, -061, -113, -196 from PNG/Outline (2x) (148 px, unmodified in src/), resized to 64 and 128 px
sets.fair_play: A static image drawn at the client's own reticle centre; computes nothing.

sets.title: Sixth-sense icons
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.contents: 4 icons (lamp, eye, badge, marks): SVG sources, RGBA PNG 64 and 128 px plus a dimmed frame of each for the pulse
sets.fair_play: Shown when the client's own sixth-sense lamp lights, for the player's own vehicle.

sets.title: Sixth-sense chime
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.copyright: Три отметки, dedicated to the public domain
sets.contents: sixthSense.mp3 (lamp on), sixthSense_off.mp3 (lamp off) and otmetki_tick.mp3 (a second of the lamp countdown): synthesised by tools/assets/sound.py, MP3 44.1 kHz mono
sets.fair_play: The client's own custom detection sound slot (Settings > Sound > detection alert: user sound); the tick counts down the player's own lamp.

sets.title: Damage-log kind glyphs
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.contents: 6 damage-kind glyphs (damage, radio, track, stun, blocked, received) and 5 vehicle-class glyphs (class_light, class_medium, class_heavy, class_td, class_spg): SVG sources, RGBA PNG 32 px
sets.fair_play: Decorates the player's own damage-log lines; the class glyph shows the vehicle class the player panels already show.

sets.title: Goal completion chime
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.copyright: Три отметки, dedicated to the public domain
sets.contents: otmetki_goal.mp3 (a goal from the site met): synthesised by tools/assets/sound.py, MP3 44.1 kHz mono
sets.fair_play: Played in the hangar when the site reports one of the player's own goals met.

sets.title: New personal best chime
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.copyright: Три отметки, dedicated to the public domain
sets.contents: otmetki_record.mp3 (a new personal best on the tank): synthesised by tools/assets/sound.py, MP3 44.1 kHz mono
sets.fair_play: Played in the hangar after a battle that beat the player's own record on the tank.
